attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: user_registration_and_profile_setup
steps:
  - id: receive_registration_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      source: mobile_app
      required_fields:
        - email
        - password
        - first_name
        - last_name
        - fitness_goals
        - current_weight
        - height
        - dietary_preferences
    output: registration_data

  - id: create_auth_account
    op: create_authentication_account
    params:
      provider: backend_as_a_service
      email: "{{ registration_data.email }}"
      password: "{{ registration_data.password }}"
    output: auth_account

  - id: validate_profile_data
    op: validate_fields
    params:
      fields:
        first_name: "{{ registration_data.first_name }}"
        last_name: "{{ registration_data.last_name }}"
        fitness_goals: "{{ registration_data.fitness_goals }}"
        current_weight: "{{ registration_data.current_weight }}"
        height: "{{ registration_data.height }}"
        dietary_preferences: "{{ registration_data.dietary_preferences }}"
      validation_rules:
        current_weight:
          type: number
          min: 1
        height:
          type: number
          min: 1
        fitness_goals:
          type: list
          allowed_values:
            - weight_loss
            - muscle_gain
            - endurance
            - flexibility
            - general_fitness
        dietary_preferences:
          type: list
          allowed_values:
            - omnivore
            - vegetarian
            - vegan
            - keto
            - paleo
            - gluten_free
            - no_preference
    output: validated_profile_data

  - id: create_user_profile
    op: create_record
    params:
      collection: user_profiles
      depends_on: create_auth_account
      data:
        auth_uid: "{{ auth_account.uid }}"
        email: "{{ registration_data.email }}"
        first_name: "{{ validated_profile_data.first_name }}"
        last_name: "{{ validated_profile_data.last_name }}"
        fitness_goals: "{{ validated_profile_data.fitness_goals }}"
        current_weight: "{{ validated_profile_data.current_weight }}"
        height: "{{ validated_profile_data.height }}"
        dietary_preferences: "{{ validated_profile_data.dietary_preferences }}"
        created_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: user_profile

  - id: log_registration_event
    op: log_event
    params:
      event_type: user_registration
      details:
        auth_uid: "{{ auth_account.uid }}"
        profile_id: "{{ user_profile.id }}"
        email: "{{ registration_data.email }}"
        timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
    output: registration_log_entry
